title: Telemetry — F09 historical recording stream
description: Bounded F09 recording replay through processing-backed SQL. Native boot time, separate association uncertainty and last reported pipeline progress; no live aircraft connectivity claim.

options.content:
**Historical recording.** This view follows one declared F09 interval, up to the complete flight, through processing-backed SQL. Refresh is every five seconds. Pipeline **recorded_replay / running / paused / completed / stopped / failed** describes the replay; paused, completed or stopped is not live device connectivity. A retained position is historical. Status is the last reported observation and may outlive a worker. Missing metrics remain **Unknown**; no monitoring or connectivity health is inferred.

Charts use **native boot seconds**, not physical UTC or arrival time. Battery timestamps retain publication-time meaning; past-only battery/state associations use an inclusive one-second age bound and separate gap masks. Missing values and ages remain NULL/Unknown. Matched values do not prove physical simultaneity. Raw flags and mode codes do not establish flight phases, safety or source completeness. Pipeline written_ms is wall-clock observation time only. Charts and the route show the first recorded sample in each one-second native bucket, so a complete flight stays inside the 4,096-row display cap; a NULL first sample stays Unknown. Budget overruns fail rather than truncate silently. The offline map uses bundled country boundaries and no external tiles.

panels.title: Logical GPS measurements
panels.description: Distinct GPS identities in the logical measurements view. Counts alone do not prove reconciliation or archive coverage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(event_id) AS logical_gps_count FROM ${database}.points LIMIT 1 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Last reported replay status
panels.description: Last reported pipeline state, not aircraft connectivity or worker liveness. An absent report is Unknown; a retained report may be stale.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM ${database}.progress ORDER BY written_ms DESC,input_next DESC,output_count DESC LIMIT 1 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Last reported pipeline progress
panels.description: Input next offset, reported output count and expected GPS facts are pipeline observations. written_ms is report wall time in Unix milliseconds, not measurement time. This is the latest report, not an atomic SQL/progress snapshot or a reconciliation verdict.

targets.rawSql: SELECT written_ms,status,input_next,output_count,expected FROM ${database}.progress ORDER BY written_ms DESC,input_next DESC,output_count DESC LIMIT 1 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Historical route and last recorded position — offline map
panels.description: All admitted positions in the selected bounded interval; the larger marker is the last recorded position. No live connection is inferred. Bundled geography only; the loopback tile endpoint disables remote tiles.

targets.rawSql: SELECT latitude_deg AS latitude,longitude_deg AS longitude FROM ${database}.points WHERE latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY native_seconds DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

SELECT tupleElement(argMin(tuple(latitude_deg,longitude_deg),native_timestamp_us),1) AS latitude,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(latitude_deg,longitude_deg),native_timestamp_us),2) AS longitude,min(native_timestamp_us) AS first_us FROM ${database}.points WHERE latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY intDiv(native_timestamp_us,1000000) ORDER BY first_us LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: GPS ground speed (m/s)
panels.description: Selected interval in native boot seconds; no physical UTC is inferred. Points preserve unobserved intervals and NULL values; no interpolation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(native_seconds) AS native_seconds,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(ground_speed_m_s),native_timestamp_us),1) AS ground_speed_m_s FROM ${database}.points GROUP BY intDiv(native_timestamp_us,1000000) ORDER BY native_seconds LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Battery association quality
panels.description: Separate battery association statuses, counts and matched-age bounds in seconds. Unknown values and ages remain NULL. A matched battery may still have an unknown current; no missing value is replaced with zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT battery_status,count() AS gps_facts,min(battery_age_us)/1000000.0 AS min_battery_age_s,max(battery_age_us)/1000000.0 AS max_battery_age_s FROM ${database}.points GROUP BY battery_status ORDER BY battery_status LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Association ages (s)
panels.description: Past-only age at each GPS observation, separately for battery, land detector and commander. Unknown association ages remain NULL; the inclusive match bound is one second.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(native_seconds) AS native_seconds,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(battery_age_us/1000000.0),native_timestamp_us),1) AS battery_age_s,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(land_age_us/1000000.0),native_timestamp_us),1) AS land_age_s,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(vehicle_status_age_us/1000000.0),native_timestamp_us),1) AS vehicle_status_age_s FROM ${database}.points GROUP BY intDiv(native_timestamp_us,1000000) ORDER BY native_seconds LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Raw recorded land-detector flags
panels.description: Recorded raw flag values, with separate association quality below. Missing flags stay NULL. These observations do not classify physical flight phases.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(native_seconds) AS native_seconds,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(landed),native_timestamp_us),1) AS landed,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(ground_contact),native_timestamp_us),1) AS ground_contact,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(maybe_landed),native_timestamp_us),1) AS maybe_landed FROM ${database}.points GROUP BY intDiv(native_timestamp_us,1000000) ORDER BY native_seconds LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Raw recorded commander values
panels.description: Original arming/nav state codes and failsafe flag without decoding, phase inference or safety assessment. Missing values stay NULL; association quality appears separately.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(native_seconds) AS native_seconds,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(arming_state),native_timestamp_us),1) AS arming_state,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(nav_state),native_timestamp_us),1) AS nav_state,tupleElement(argMin(tuple(failsafe),native_timestamp_us),1) AS failsafe FROM ${database}.points GROUP BY intDiv(native_timestamp_us,1000000) ORDER BY native_seconds LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Recorded state association quality — separate streams
panels.description: Land-detector and commander association statuses remain separate. A match in one stream does not fill an unknown in the other. Recording gaps, stale and before-first states remain visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT land_status,vehicle_status_status,count() AS gps_facts FROM ${database}.points GROUP BY land_status,vehicle_status_status ORDER BY land_status,vehicle_status_status LIMIT 4096 SETTINGS readonly=1,max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw',max_result_rows=4096,max_result_bytes=4194304,result_overflow_mode='throw'
